name: TestEnumeration
summary: Builds the suite from an explicit list, so that exactly the intended tests run and no more.

roles.name: TestEnumeration
roles.summary: The counterpart of discovery: the tests are named, in one place, by hand. It costs an edit per test and buys certainty about what runs — and the failure it exists against is the opposite one, a test written and never added, which is why annotating the list is what lets a rule compare it to what exists.
